title: Verify skill coverage record
description: coverage.json of a formal verify skill (.agents/skills/toolkit-verify-<repo>-<subsystem>/). check-drift.mjs reads it to find the code each check covers and the commit at which the model last matched that code.

repo.description: The repo's name as the project registry (toolkit-context --repo) lists it

syncCommit.description: Trunk commit at which the model was last confirmed to describe every covered file

property.description: The invariant or property name in the model's config

rule.description: The property as one sentence in the reader's words

model.description: Path to the model, relative to the verify skill

path.description: File or directory relative to the repo root; never a line number

symbols.description: Substrings that must appear in the file

role.description: What the model takes from this file

replay.description: Path to the replay test, relative to the verify skill
